item.title: Shopify moves back to Native from React Native
item.description:
📝 Here’s why Shopify is moving from React Native back to Swift and Kotlin. Why switch back to native We decided to switch from native to React Native in 2020 for three reasons: Stop building the same features twice Allow developers to work across the stack Spend less time chasing feature parity and more time shipping value React Native consistently delivered these benefits. React Native apps can be fast.
🔗 Read more: https://shopify.engineering/back-to-native

item.title: The first drink-driving conviction may have happened in London
Who People Talk to When They're Struggling
item.description:
📝 ” Then respondents rated several options:Close Friends Spouse/Partner Immediate Family Member Mental Health Therapist A Co-Worker Neighbor Religious/Spiritual LeaderLet’s start with the share of each religious group who said they were extremely or very comfortable talking about their mental health with each of those individuals. Only about a third of non-evangelical Protestants, Catholics, and LDS members feel very or extremely comfortable speaking with their pastor about their struggles. They are actually slightly more comfortable talking with their pastor (56%) than with a therapist (51%) regarding their emotional well-being.
🔗 Read more: https://www.graphsaboutreligion.com/p/who-do-you-talk-to-when-youre-struggling
